issues.description: Cluster inventory matches the final reported 58 cell populations (15 epithelial, 9 endothelial, 9 stromal, 25 immune); no evidence of missing clusters.

Several flow-cytometry marker designations (CD3, CD8, CD16, CD57, HLA-DR, IgM/IgD) are antigen/complex names or non-unique gene targets; they are marked unresolved rather than excluded solely on tissue/species grounds.
Formal markers from mouse experiments (Eln, Slc7a10, Fgfr4, Serpinf1, Pi16) are retained as new findings/verifications despite task species being human, per scope-neutral policy.
Many immune antibody panels are treated as formal marker sets because they were used to sort canonical immune populations whose transcriptional profiles were then used for cluster annotation.
